pages.text:
幼儿园的早晨，教室里传来一阵哭声。小猫同学菲菲坐在角落里，灰白色的小耳朵耷拉着，眼泪啪嗒啪嗒地掉。
艳艳老师蹲下来轻轻拍她的背：「菲菲不哭，老师在这里。」
pages.text_en:
It was morning at kindergarten. Crying echoed through the classroom. Feifei the kitten sat in the corner, her grey-and-white ears drooping, tears falling pitter-patter.
Teacher Yanyan knelt down and gently patted her back: "Don't cry, Feifei. Teacher is right here."

pages.text:
咘咘坐在自己的小椅子上，安安静静地看着菲菲。她没有哭，两只白色的长耳朵竖得高高的。
NOMI 在她旁边小声说：「菲菲好伤心呀。」
咘咘点点头：「可是咘咘今天不哭。咘咘是大小朋友了。」
pages.text_en:
Bubu sat in her little chair, quietly watching Feifei. She wasn't crying. Her two white ears stood tall.
NOMI whispered beside her: "Feifei is so sad."
Bubu nodded: "But Bubu isn't crying today. Bubu is a big kid now."

pages.text:
一整天，菲菲哭了好几次。但每次咘咘都勇敢地坐在座位上，认真听老师讲故事，还举手回答了问题。
NONO 骄傲地站在咘咘头顶：「叽叽！咘咘好棒！」
pages.text_en:
Throughout the day, Feifei cried several times. But each time, Bubu sat bravely in her seat, listening carefully to the teacher's stories and even raising her hand to answer questions.
NONO perched proudly on Bubu's head: "Chirp! Bubu is amazing!"

pages.text:
下午放学的铃声响了。咘咘背上小书包，跑到幼儿园门口。外公和外婆已经站在那里等她了！
「外公！外婆！」咘咘像一只小白兔跳进了外公的怀里。
pages.text_en:
The afternoon bell rang. Bubu put on her little backpack and ran to the kindergarten gate. Grandpa and Grandma were already waiting!
"Grandpa! Grandma!" Bubu hopped into Grandpa's arms like a little white bunny.

pages.text:
外婆牵着咘咘的手，笑眯眯地说：「咘咘今天乖不乖呀？」
咘咘骄傲地挺起小胸膛：「咘咘今天一次都没有哭！」
外公竖起大拇指：「咘咘真厉害！」
pages.text_en:
Grandma held Bubu's hand and smiled: "Was Bubu a good girl today?"
Bubu puffed up her little chest proudly: "Bubu didn't cry at all today!"
Grandpa gave a thumbs up: "Bubu is amazing!"

pages.text:
外公开着车，带咘咘去了一个特别的地方——Sam 爸爸的公司！
咘咘趴在车窗上，看着窗外的大楼越来越近：「爸爸的公司到了吗？到了吗？」
pages.text_en:
Grandpa drove and took Bubu to a special place — Sam Dad's office!
Bubu pressed her face against the car window, watching the buildings get closer: "Are we there yet? Are we there yet?"

pages.text:
一走进爸爸的公司，咘咘的眼睛就亮了！桌上摆着好多好多玩具，还有好几台游戏机！
「哇——」咘咘张大了嘴巴。
Sam 爸爸蹲下来张开双臂：「欢迎咘咘来爸爸的公司！」
pages.text_en:
The moment Bubu walked into Dad's office, her eyes lit up! There were so many toys on the tables, and even several game consoles!
"Wow—" Bubu's mouth fell open.
Sam Dad knelt down with open arms: "Welcome to Daddy's office, Bubu!"

pages.text:
爸爸的同事们都围过来了。叔叔阿姨们弯下腰，笑着跟咘咘打招呼。
「这就是咘咘呀？好可爱！」
「咘咘，要不要吃糖？」
咘咘有点害羞，躲在爸爸腿后面，偷偷露出半个脑袋，小声说：「谢谢叔叔阿姨。」
pages.text_en:
Dad's colleagues all gathered around. The uncles and aunties bent down and greeted Bubu with big smiles.
"So this is Bubu? How cute!"
"Bubu, would you like some candy?"
Bubu felt a little shy, hiding behind Dad's legs, peeking out with half her face: "Thank you, uncle and auntie."

pages.text:
咘咘很快就不害羞了。她坐在爸爸的大椅子上，脚悬在半空中晃呀晃，开心地玩着游戏机。
NOMI 在旁边帮她按按钮：「这个这个，按这个！」
NONO 在屏幕前飞来飞去：「叽叽！我也要玩！」
pages.text_en:
Bubu quickly got over her shyness. She sat in Dad's big office chair, her feet dangling and swinging, happily playing with a game console.
NOMI helped press buttons beside her: "This one! Press this one!"
NONO flew back and forth in front of the screen: "Chirp! I want to play too!"

pages.text:
吃完晚饭，外公开车带大家去接妈妈。远远地，咘咘就看到了 Tina 妈妈站在路边。
「妈妈！妈妈！」咘咘从车窗里拼命挥手。
pages.text_en:
After dinner, Grandpa drove everyone to pick up Mom. From far away, Bubu spotted Tina Mom standing by the road.
"Mommy! Mommy!" Bubu waved wildly from the car window.

pages.text:
咘咘扑进妈妈的怀里，仰起小脸，眼睛亮晶晶的：
「妈妈！咘咘今天在幼儿园一次都没有哭！菲菲哭了好几次，但是咘咘没有哭！咘咘变得很棒了！」
妈妈把咘咘抱得紧紧的，眼睛里闪着泪光：「咘咘真的好棒好棒！妈妈太高兴了！」
pages.text_en:
Bubu jumped into Mom's arms, looking up with sparkling eyes:
"Mommy! Bubu didn't cry at all at kindergarten today! Feifei cried many times, but Bubu didn't! Bubu is really great now!"
Mom hugged Bubu tightly, tears of joy glistening in her eyes: "Bubu is so wonderful! Mommy is SO happy!"

pages.text:
回到家，妈妈帮咘咘洗了澡，换上了软软的睡衣。咘咘躺在被窝里，妈妈在旁边轻轻拍着她。
「妈妈，咘咘现在是大小朋友了吗？」
「是呀，咘咘是最棒的大小朋友。」
pages.text_en:
Back home, Mom gave Bubu a bath and dressed her in soft pajamas. Bubu lay in bed while Mom gently patted her.
"Mommy, is Bubu a big kid now?"
"Yes, Bubu is the most amazing big kid."

pages.text:
NOMI 和 NONO 趴在枕头旁边，小声说：「晚安，大小朋友咘咘。」
咘咘抱着小兔子玩偶，闭上眼睛，嘴角挂着甜甜的微笑。
今天，咘咘没有哭。
因为她，真的长大了一点点。
pages.text_en:
NOMI and NONO snuggled beside the pillow and whispered: "Good night, big kid Bubu."
Bubu hugged her little bunny plushie, closed her eyes, and smiled sweetly.
Today, Bubu didn't cry.
Because she really did grow up, just a little bit.

pages.text:
夜空中，一颗星星特别特别亮。
那是属于每一个勇敢的小朋友的星星。

—— 全剧终 ——
pages.text_en:
In the night sky, one star shone especially bright.
It was the star for every brave little kid.

— The End —
